records.label: spacr.active_learning.margin#1
records.source: This returns an uncertainty score, **not** the margin: a small margin (the two leading classes neck and neck) is a large return value, so it is oriented like every other measure here. Minimum 0 at a one-hot row, maximum 1 at any row whose top two classes tie.
records.context: This returns an uncertainty score, **not** the margin: a small margin (the two leading classes neck and neck) is a large return value, so it is oriented like every other measure here. Minimum 0 at a one-hot row, maximum 1 at any row whose top two classes tie.
records.translation: Þetta skilar óvissustigi, **ekki** bilinu: lítið bil milli tveggja efstu flokkanna gefur hátt skilagildi, svo stefnan er sú sama og hjá öllum öðrum mælingum hér. Lágmarkið er 0 fyrir röð með einu gildinu 1; hámarkið er 1 þegar tveir efstu flokkarnir eru jafnir.

records.label: spacr.qt.walkthrough.register_steps#1
records.source: The seam a module uses to say something the layout cannot — "run test mode on three fields before committing a plate" is advice, not structure, and no amount of reading the settings map produces it.
records.context: The seam a module uses to say something the layout cannot — "run test mode on three microscope fields of view before committing a laboratory microplate" is advice, not structure, and no amount of reading the settings map produces it.
records.translation: Saumurinn sem eining notar til að segja það sem útlitið getur ekki sagt — "keyrðu prófunarham á þremur sjónsviðum áður en örplatan er staðfest" er ráðlegging en ekki formgerð, og lestur stillingavörpunarinnar leiðir hana aldrei í ljós.

records.label: spacr.predictions.migrate_prediction_columns#2
records.source: **Idempotent.** After the repair the column holds 0s and 1s, which is not the encoding this looks for, so a second pass does nothing.
records.context: **Idempotent.** After the repair the column holds 0s and 1s, which is not the encoding this looks for, so a second pass does nothing.
records.translation: **Óbreytanlegt.** Eftir viðgerðina inniheldur dálkurinn núll og einn; það er ekki kóðunin sem leitað er að, svo önnur umferð gerir ekkert.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.scores_frame#1
records.source: Every original column is kept, which is the whole point: it is what lets the scores plot colour by ``gene``, facet by ``plateID`` and publish a real object-key selection when a cluster is brushed. The Graph Builder then draws it with no knowledge that it is a PCA.
records.context: Every original column is kept, which is the whole point: it is what lets the scores plot colour by ``gene``, facet by ``plateID`` and publish a real object-structured-data name selection when a cluster is brushed. The Graph Builder then draws it with no knowledge that it is a PCA.
records.translation: Öllum upprunalegum dálkum er haldið, sem er einmitt tilgangurinn: þá getur stigadreifiritið litað eftir ``gene``, flokkað eftir ``plateID`` og birt raunverulegt val hlutalykils þegar klasi er burstaður. Graph Builder teiknar það síðan án þess að vita að um PCA sé að ræða.

records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#6
records.source: :func:`register` is the whole of the installation and is idempotent, so a build whose launch list has not yet learned about this module can call it from anywhere that runs before the first window.
records.context: :func:`register` is the whole of the installation and is idempotent, so a build whose launch list has not yet learned about this module can call it from anywhere that executes before the first window.
records.translation: :func:`register` sér um alla uppsetninguna og er óbreytanlegt, svo smíði sem hefur ekki enn bætt þessari einingu við ræsilistann getur kallað það hvar sem er áður en fyrsti glugginn opnast.

records.label: spacr.object_roles.organelle_settings_view#1
records.source: The classical organelle segmenter predates slots and reads roughly forty ``organelle_*`` keys. Keeping that well-tested implementation and adapting one settings view at its boundary prevents four copies of the algorithm.
records.context: The classical organelle segmenter predates slots and reads roughly forty ``organelle_*`` structured-data names. Keeping that microplate sample position-tested implementation and adapting one settings view at its boundary prevents four copies of the algorithm.
records.translation: Klassíska frumulíffærahlutunarlíkanið er eldra en hlutverkaraufarnar og les um fjörutíu ``organelle_*`` stillingarlykla. Með því að halda vel prófaðri útfærslu og aðlaga eina stillingasýn við mörk hennar þarf ekki fjögur afrit af reikniritinu.
